# FRAME: night shift swaps

## Job statement (anchor-stripped)

When a night nurse cannot work a shift, she wants to hand it to a qualified colleague, so she can rest without
leaving the ward short.

## Problem

How might we help night nurses settle swaps for their wards so that no shift goes unfilled?

## Audience / boundary

Night-shift nurses in one hospital.

## Success looks like

Swaps settle within one shift; baseline NOT VERIFIED.

## Hard constraints (gates)

Data stays in the EU.

## Soft constraints

Prefer managed services.

## Non-goals

Payroll.

## Decision ledger

| # | decision | answer | status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | region | EU | CONFIRMED |

## Premises

P1 Nurses swap at least monthly. NOT VERIFIED.

## Kill condition for the whole effort

Wards already settle swaps within a shift.
